heading: Here's who shows up at your door — and your job site
line: Every plumber on our crew is licensed, insured, background-checked, and drives a marked R.S. Johnson truck.

groupPhoto.alt: Whole crew standing in front of two marked company trucks
groupPhoto.caption: Whole crew in front of two trucks

members.name: Ryan Johnson
members.title: Owner · Master Plumber
members.role: Runs every bid, walks every job, and still takes service calls
members.bio: I started R.S. Johnson Plumbing in [year] after [#] years working for other outfits, because I wanted to do the work the way I'd want it done in my own house: show up when we say we will, leave it cleaner than we found it, and explain what we fixed and why. Most of our work is new construction and remodels for builders across St. Charles County, and we take on homeowner repairs in between. I've lived in O'Fallon since [year] with [family detail], and there's a good chance we've already worked on a house on your street.

photo.alt: Ryan Johnson in a company shirt in front of an R.S. Johnson Plumbing truck
photo.caption: Ryan in company shirt in front of truck

members.name: Mike Delgado
members.title: Master Plumber
members.role: Leads most of our new-construction rough-ins.
members.bio: Mike has been plumbing for 14 years and is the one Ryan puts on a job when the framing crew is moving fast and the underground has to be right the first time. He grew up in St. Peters, and his weekends belong to his daughter's softball schedule.

photo.alt: Mike Delgado, Master Plumber, in a company shirt
photo.caption: Mike in company shirt

members.name: Tyler Brandt
members.title: Master Plumber
members.role: Your service call for water heaters, leaks, and repairs.
members.bio: Tyler has been plumbing for 9 years and handles most of our homeowner repair calls — if you've got no hot water on a Sunday, he's the truck you'll see pull up. He lives in Wentzville with his wife and two dogs and is a lifelong Cardinals fan, for better or worse.

photo.alt: Tyler Brandt, Master Plumber, in a company shirt
photo.caption: Tyler in company shirt

members.name: Chris Okafor
members.title: Master Plumber
members.role: Trim-out and fixture specialist on custom homes.
members.bio: Chris has been plumbing for 11 years and does most of our finish work — setting fixtures, tile-side details, and the final walkthroughs with builders and homeowners. He's from Lake St. Louis originally and restores old pickup trucks when he's not on a job.

photo.alt: Chris Okafor, Master Plumber, in a company shirt
photo.caption: Chris in company shirt

members.name: Danny Reyes
members.title: Master Plumber
members.role: Drains, sewer lines, and the jobs nobody else wants.
members.bio: Danny has been plumbing for 8 years and runs our drain and sewer work, from camera inspections to full line replacements. He grew up in Dardenne Prairie, still lives a few miles from where he was raised, and is the guy on the crew who brings the donuts.

photo.alt: Danny Reyes, Master Plumber, in a company shirt
photo.caption: Danny in company shirt
